claims.assertion: Mari says the Federation applies the Prime Directive selectively on Earth, an isolated realm with at least 900 large ships nearby.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari alleges the Federation ultimately controls Earth’s money and regional budgets because money is a key tool for planetary control.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says Federation grants fund humanoid visitors’ Earth operations, with budgets that can be cut; Taygeta gets little, Swaruu none.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says Greys and other groups operate outside human money rules, sustaining hostile-alien and benevolent-Federation narratives.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
